eligibleItems.title: Brace-Aware Structured Output Extraction (extractJSON)
eligibleItems.negativeConstraints: ANTI-PATTERN: Never use naive global regex (e.g. /\{[\s\S]*\}/) to extract JSON from conversational LLM outputs. It greedily collapses multiple objects and breaks on conversational preambles.
eligibleItems.technicalPrinciple: Parse JSON using balanced brace-depth tracking with explicit string-literal boundaries and escape tracking. Fall back from fast JSON.parse to bracket-matching slice.

operationalBounds.whenToApply: Whenever consuming untrusted, conversational, or Markdown-fenced JSON responses from LLM API completions.
operationalBounds.whenNotToApply: Internal deterministic IPC or binary serialization protocols where input is guaranteed well-formed JSON.

eligibleItems.title: GitHub-Standard Documentation Anchor & TOC Synchronization Invariant
eligibleItems.negativeConstraints: ANTI-PATTERN: Do not link headings with un-slugified text, unescaped spaces, or raw uppercase anchors in Markdown documents. Links will silently break in rendered GitHub/GitLab viewports.
eligibleItems.technicalPrinciple: Downcase heading text, strip punctuation preserving Unicode letters (\p{L}\p{N}), convert spaces to single hyphens, strip leading/trailing hyphens, and maintain a stateful set for sequential duplicate disambiguation (-1, -2).

operationalBounds.whenToApply: When generating documentation indices, README table-of-contents, or knowledge graph link anchors.
operationalBounds.whenNotToApply: Arbitrary URL query parameters or REST API endpoint paths.

eligibleItems.title: Safe Binary Model Header Inspection & Allocation Guard
eligibleItems.negativeConstraints: ANTI-PATTERN: Never allocate memory buffers based directly on untrusted binary header size declarations without clamping against an explicit safety envelope (default 25 MB).
eligibleItems.technicalPrinciple: Verify format magic bytes (GGUF: 0x46554747) and version bounds (v1-v3) or Safetensors 8-byte uint64 LE header size before allocating buffers or initiating model weight deserialization.

operationalBounds.whenToApply: Model gateways, weight download caches, and model inference servers loading binary tensor weights from external sources.
operationalBounds.whenNotToApply: Static text files or non-binary configuration formats.

eligibleItems.title: Reusable Zero-Dependency CLI Command Dispatcher
eligibleItems.negativeConstraints: ANTI-PATTERN: Do not write ad-hoc procedural argument slicing in CLI entrypoints. Always enforce strict exit-code contracts (0, 1, 2) and automated help text.
eligibleItems.technicalPrinciple: Modular command registration with automated help manual formatting, option parsing, positional argument bounds checks, and standard exit codes.

operationalBounds.whenToApply: Building standalone CLI tools or agent automation scripts requiring clear user manuals and predictable exit codes.
operationalBounds.whenNotToApply: Headless backend microservices without command-line interfaces.

eligibleItems.title: Post-Extraction Schema Invariant Validator Contract
eligibleItems.negativeConstraints: ANTI-PATTERN: Do not allow unvalidated, loosely-typed JSON objects to flow from LLM extraction into core application logic without contract assertions.
eligibleItems.technicalPrinciple: Zero-dependency contract validation asserting required fields, primitive types, non-empty strings, positive numeric bounds, enums, array item schemas, and strict unlisted property guards.

operationalBounds.whenToApply: Validating structured LLM outputs immediately following extractJSON().
operationalBounds.whenNotToApply: High-frequency streaming telemetry where schema assertions introduce intolerable latency.
